_note: Hebrew lines for a GIRL (?g=f). Same ids as lines-en.json. Identical to lines-he-m.json except where Hebrew is gendered: imperatives (בואי/תחזרי/תקפיאי/תקשיבי/תעמדי), the את pronoun that forces the feminine 2nd-person past pronunciation, and אלופת / שחקנית / מדהימה. The COMMANDS are byte-identical to the boy file on purpose — a shouted order in a kids' game carries no gender, and keeping them identical means both children hear exactly the same command timing.
